elan_i2chid_tools: Elan Tools for Auto-Update (AU) This patch is for Elan tools for Auto-Update: elan_i2chid_iap and elan_i2chid_read_fwid. The first tool is a firmware update tool for i2chid device. The second tool is a firmware ID lookup tool with configuration file. This tool is used to get the firmware ID and find an appropriate FW. Its configuration file may need to be updated if panels changed. These two binary tools are installed to /usr/sbin. The configuration file is installed to /usr/share/elan_i2chid_tools. Command: (Take INX panel for example, HID PID: 0x2a03) Read FWID: (root) ./i2chid_read_fwid -P 2a03 -f fwid_mapping_table.txt -s chrome -q FW Update: (root) ./i2chid_iap_v2 -P 2a03 -f firmware.bin -q BUG=b:128880259 TEST=on Elan Touchscreen, read firmware ID, update firmware, and touchscreen works. Change-Id: I4a44cebc659d5d4986ac6315357edfd90081d92e Signed-off-by: Paul Liang <paul.liang@emc.com.tw> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1617060 Tested-by: Karen Chou <karen.chou@elan.corp-partner.google.com> Commit-Ready: Karen Chou <karen.chou@elan.corp-partner.google.com> Commit-Ready: Trent Begin <tbegin@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Trent Begin <tbegin@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Crag.Wang <crag_wang@dell.corp-partner.google.com> Reviewed-by: Simon Glass <sjg@chromium.org>

CRAS: hfp_slc - Fix AT+BCS reply OK According to HFP 1.7.1 spec The AG shall always respond with OK if the ID received in AT+BCS is the same as the one sent, and with ERROR otherwise. Airpod headset is affected by the bug. Fix it so that OK is sent as reply to AT+BCS= command before we initialize HFP AG. BUG=chromium:980454 TEST=Manual test Airpod in wideband speech mode. Change-Id: I6036385c896b10796e6ba1c78d28fb5694dab2ee Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1716472 Tested-by: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Hsinyu Chao <hychao@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: En-Shuo Hsu <enshuo@google.com>

ml: Implement model-specific metric reports to UMA In the previous code, the metrics of each type of system resource usage (RAM, cpu time etc.) are aggregated over all the models. So one cannot see the resource usage of a particular model. In this CL, we make such metrics and reports (to UMA) model-specific. For example, assume there are two models with |metric_base_name| "SmartDimModel" and "TestModel", respectively. In logging the cpu usage of model loading, the preivous code will only generate one histogram on UMA: MachineLearningService.LoadModelResult.CpuTimeMicrosec which contains metrics of both "SmartDimModel" and "TestModel". Now there will be two histograms, MachineLearningService.SmartDimModel.LoadModelResult.CpuTimeMicrosec MachineLearningService.TestModel.LoadModelResult.CpuTimeMicrosec which record the metrics for each model separately. This is achieved by requiring model owners to specify a metrics_model_name in their ModelMetadata. BUG=chromium:924709 TEST=test on device TEST=histogram names of TestModel are correct TEST=histogram name of model specification error is correct Change-Id: Id55b9d0385ec80e0606fa4d663dbd2bcc9c24cf3 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1710251 Tested-by: Honglin Yu <honglinyu@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Honglin Yu <honglinyu@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Andrew Moylan <amoylan@chromium.org>
